o1: Predicted to enable adenylate cyclase activity; guanylate cyclase activity; and peptide receptor activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to cGMP; determination of adult lifespan; olfactory learning; and dauer larval development. Is located in dendrite; neuronal cell body; and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in amphid neurons. Is part of the guanylyl cyclase signaling pathway.
